one_line: Nvidia faces leadership turmoil, antitrust probes, and congressional inquiries following CEO Jensen Huang's resignation.

themes.title: Nvidia leadership change triggers federal probes
themes.text: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned following revelations about personal relationships, leading to Colette Kress being named interim CEO. Former Huang has agreed to testify before Congress, while the DOJ, lawmakers, and Senate committees opened antitrust and national security inquiries.

stories.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns following revelations about personal relationships
Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress by Thanksgiving
US DOJ opens antitrust and related probes involving Nvidia
Democrats launch Nvidia investigation into China chip sales and Trump deal
Senate Banking Chair Tim Scott asks Jensen Huang and Howard Lutnick to testify
US officials disagree on whether Alice Huang spied for China
Report details past clash between Jensen Huang and interim CEO Colette Kress

themes.title: Chinese AI models show Nvidia hardware
themes.text: A forensic study found hardware fingerprints matching Nvidia Blackwell GPUs in six Chinese AI models. Meanwhile, Nvidia privately confirmed to U.S. lawmakers that it could implement anti-smuggling chip tracking measures.

stories.headline: Forensic analysis finds six Chinese AI models show NVIDIA Blackwell GPU fingerprints
Nvidia privately confirmed it could track chips to fight smuggling

themes.title: Anthropic IPO oversubscribed amid cloud financing
themes.text: Anthropic’s IPO is heavily oversubscribed, targeting a $1.4 trillion valuation. Cloud provider Nscale disclosed financing needs and debt following a major Anthropic contract, while Nebius outlined a multi-billion-dollar capex plan for 2027.

stories.headline: Anthropic IPO draws about six times the orders for available shares
Nscale says it needs extra funding for 2027 commitments after $45B Anthropic chip order
Nscale reports $5.5B in debt and $1.69B loss in amended IPO filing
Nebius outlines $40‑45 billion 2027 capex plan funded by customer pre‑payments

themes.title: New AI models and shopping tools
themes.text: OpenAI launched the ChatGPT Wallet for AI agent shopping and two security products under its Daybreak platform. Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, replacing its Flash model across Google Search and the Gemini app.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory security products
OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for AI agent shopping
Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast model for everyday coding and search
